summary: Owns a lightweight RTCP reader/writer adapter that invokes packet and close callbacks.
responsibilities: Store RTCP reader SSRC and close state.
Invoke packet callbacks when RTCP bytes are written.
Satisfy read/write closer style interfaces used by buffer factories.

summary: Stores RTCP reader identity, close state, and packet or close callbacks.

inner.summary: SSRC associated with this RTCP reader.
Records whether the reader has been closed.
Callback invoked when the reader closes.

summary: Constructs an RTCP reader for the supplied SSRC.
Delivers written RTCP bytes to the packet callback unless the reader is closed.
summary_step: 1. Returns EOF when the reader has already been closed.
2. Loads the packet callback atomically and checks that it is present.
3. Invokes the callback with the written bytes and returns without consuming count accounting.

summary: Stores the callback invoked on close.
Closes the reader once and invokes the close callback.
summary_step: 1. Atomically marks the reader closed and returns immediately when it was already closed.

summary: Atomically stores the callback invoked for written RTCP packets.
No-op read implementation that returns zero values.
